title: Silent River That Never Freezes

scenes.text: The River Thames never freezes, even at minus ten degrees.
A strong current of about 1.5 m/s keeps the water moving quickly.
London winters often drop to around -5°C, yet the surface stays unfrozen.
A small amount of dissolved minerals from upstream lowers the freezing point, so the water stays liquid.
